sequences.description: Direct endpoint attack: attempt to smuggle attacker-controlled authorization parameters via an unsigned (alg=none) OIDC request object; server should reject or not accept it as a valid proof.

oracle_checks.violation_description: Dex accepted an unsigned (alg=none) request object; if processed, this breaks proof integrity by allowing attacker-controlled authorization parameters without signature verification.

sequences.description: Direct-endpoint attack: send unsigned request object (alg=none) and check whether the auth endpoint accepts it (proof integrity of request object).

oracle_checks.violation_description: Dex accepted an unsigned (alg=none) request object, indicating request parameters may be consumed without authentic proof verification (proof integrity failure).
